numeric_match_rule: Accept one JSON object, normalize numeric strings and yes/no; round(predicted,5) == canonical FinQA qa.exe_ans. Do not rescale numeric percent answers heuristically. Failed parsing and runtime errors count as incorrect.
comparison_axis: Model-generated FinQA DSL program executed by a bounded local calculator.
limitations: Small development pilot, not a leaderboard or test-set estimate.
Cross-model difference changes parameter count, quantization and engine, not a single causal factor.
Published benchmark may have training contamination.
Greedy single repetition does not estimate sampling variation.
Hardware execution timings are specific to this shared CPU environment.
One original annotation uses tangible assets while the gold corresponds to identifiable net assets; original gold remains unchanged.
